newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB raises benchmark prime rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB raises benchmark prime rate.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Friday it had raised its benchmark variable interest rate to 10.30 percent from 10.25 percent with effect from September 2.
"Movements in the benchmark rate, which applies to major corporate borrowers, reflect changes in short term interest rates," the bank said in a statement.
NAB also announced 0.5 percentage point cuts in its three, four and five-year fixed home lone rates for owner occupiers and investors.
The cuts come on the heels of Australian Bureau of Statistics data showing the nation's dwelling unit building approvals rose a seasonally adjusted 8.1 percent in July to 10,619 from 9,824 in June.
